Hollin.description: You are in Hollin, your home village. Smoke drifts from the old mill.

The Linden Wood.description: You are in the Linden Wood, a dense forest with towering trees.

Brannoc's Watch.description: You are at Brannoc's Watch, a watchtower overlooking the forest.

Ferrow Crossing.description: You are at Ferrow Crossing, where an old ferryman poles travelers across a wide, slow river.

Elsmere Town.description: You are in Elsmere Town, a busy market town full of merchants and wandering adventurers.

The Reedfens.description: You are in the Reedfens, a misty marsh where the ground squelches with every step.

Calvaren Gate.description: You are at the gate of Calvaren, a city of mages. The guards eye every traveler carrying a staff.

The Athenaeum.description: You are in the Athenaeum, a great library where scholars study spells older than the kingdom.

The Starfall Observatory.description: You are at the Starfall Observatory, a tower where mages watch the stars for signs of coming danger.

Greystone Ruins.description: You are in the Greystone Ruins, the broken remains of a fortress lost in an old war against the demons.

Moorhold Inn.description: You are at Moorhold Inn, a lonely inn on the windswept moor. A fire crackles inside.

The Barrow Fields.description: You are in the Barrow Fields, where grassy burial mounds stretch as far as you can see.

Kettle Pass.description: You are at Kettle Pass, a narrow mountain trail where loose stones clatter down the cliffs.

Harrowdeep.description: You are in Harrowdeep, a dwarven hall carved deep into the mountain.

The Summit of Vael.description: You are at the Summit of Vael. Far to the north, the land turns white with snow.

Frostmere Outpost.description: You are at Frostmere Outpost, the last manned fort before the frozen wastes.

Ysra.description: You are in Ysra, a silent village buried in snow. No one has lived here for years.

The Whitefall Glacier.description: You are on the Whitefall Glacier, a vast sheet of ice that groans beneath your feet.

The Blackened Gate.description: You are at the Blackened Gate, the entrance to the demon lord's domain. The air feels heavy and wrong.

The Hall of Ash.description: You are in the Hall of Ash, a ruined hall where gray ash falls like snow.
neighbors: The Throne of the Hollow King

The Throne of the Hollow King.description: You stand before the Throne of the Hollow King. Whatever waits here has been waiting a long time.
